Added helper M=(-0.034,-3.482) and small-circle centre S=(-0.021,-1.730) in the same frame, with radii 3.678 (big) and 1.636 (small). Required edges: CA, AB, BC solid; C-O, O-B dashed; C-P-B solid; O-P-M dashed. Dots at O and P. No right-angle marks (none verified). Repair v1: removed the duplicate \draw (B) -- (C) so the solid chord is drawn once as C -- P -- B (no overlapping strokes). Enlarged the filled dots at O and P from 2.000pt to 3.75pt radius. Removed the literal redefinitions of A, B, C, O, P because the program owns those coordinates; the previous values differed slightly (e.g. B y=-1.548 vs program -1.547, C y=-1.550 vs -1.549), so the program values now govern. Kept all other geometry (big circle at O r=3.678, small circle S r=1.636, dashed OC/OB/OM, solid CA/AB), line width 1.8pt, label font 17/20.4 and label placements unchanged. No right-angle marks (none verified).

Repair v2: label P changed from `right` to `above right` and still bound to (P), so it clears the solid CB stroke. Font, line width, dots, strokes and helper geometry are unchanged.

Coordinate definitions: the program-owned block says it inserts A, B, C, O, P, so I removed the earlier literal definitions of those five. The previous source also had slightly different values for B, C and P than the program block (for example P was (-0.021,-1.549) against the program's (-0.034,-1.552)). Keeping them would have been a redefinition. Because of this, the file only compiles standalone once the program inserts those five coordinates at the start of the tikzpicture.

For remeasurement: the helper M is at x=-0.018, but px 202 in the stated frame gives x=-0.034. The 0.016 cm offset is small, and I left it alone as instructed to keep everything else unchanged.
